name: cyborg-job-pipeline
description: Automated AI job sourcing pipeline with Gemini-powered cold email drafting and Telegram delivery

scripts.login:linkedin: ts-node -e "import { getLinkedInContext } from './src/scrapers/linkedin'; getLinkedInContext(true).then(({ context }) => { context.browser()?.close(); process.exit(0); });"
scripts.sync:cloud: ts-node -e "import { loadDrafts, syncDraftToCloud } from './src/bot-daemon'; const url = process.env.RENDER_DAEMON_URL; if (!url) { console.error('❌ RENDER_DAEMON_URL is missing in .env'); process.exit(1); } syncDraftToCloud(url, Array.from(loadDrafts().values())).then(() => console.log('✅ Local drafts synced to Render cloud!'));"
